LABEL: taste intensity level
definition: An ordinal degree at which a perceptual taste quality is reported to be present in a kind of food or drink.

LABEL: tasting phase
definition: A stage of a single tasting, from the first contact of the sample with the tongue to the sensation remaining after swallowing.

LABEL: taster group
definition: A group of human tasters sharing a characteristic relevant to how they perceive taste.

LABEL: genotype-defined taster group
definition: A taster group whose membership is defined by a genotype at a taste receptor locus.

LABEL: phenotype-defined taster group
definition: A taster group whose membership is defined by a measured taste phenotype rather than by genotype.

LABEL: taste interaction effect
definition: The direction in which one perceptual taste quality alters the perceived intensity of another.

LABEL: evidence type
definition: The kind of evidence on which a taste profile entry's claim rests.

LABEL: taste profile entry
definition: One line of the taste profile of a kind of food or drink: a single quality, at a single ordinal level, at a single phase of the tasting, holding for a single group of tasters, from a single source.

LABEL: taste interaction
definition: An asserted relation in which the presence of one perceptual taste quality alters the perceived intensity of another, as established by a cited study using named chemical stimuli.

LABEL: absent
definition: The intensity level at which a quality is reported not to be perceptible at all.

LABEL: slight
definition: The intensity level at which a quality is reported as just perceptible.

LABEL: moderate
definition: The intensity level at which a quality is reported as clearly present without dominating.

LABEL: strong
definition: The intensity level at which a quality is reported as dominating the taste.

LABEL: intense
definition: The intensity level at which a quality is reported as close to the strongest the taster can imagine.

LABEL: attack
definition: The phase of a tasting from first contact of the sample with the tongue to the first clear perception.

LABEL: mid-palate
definition: The phase of a tasting while the sample is held in the mouth, after the first perception and before swallowing or expectoration.

LABEL: finish
definition: The phase of a tasting after the sample leaves the mouth, in which remaining and newly emerging sensations are perceived.

LABEL: overall
definition: The whole of a tasting taken together, used when a report does not distinguish phases.

LABEL: general population
definition: The taster group comprising human tasters generally, used when a claim is not qualified by genotype or phenotype.

LABEL: suppression
definition: The effect in which the presence of the agent quality lowers the perceived intensity of the target quality.

LABEL: enhancement
definition: The effect in which the presence of the agent quality raises the perceived intensity of the target quality.

LABEL: literature
definition: Evidence consisting of a published study identified by a persistent identifier.

LABEL: panel data
definition: Evidence consisting of ratings collected from a trained or untrained sensory panel.

LABEL: expert assertion
definition: Evidence consisting of the judgement of a person with domain expertise, unaccompanied by data.

LABEL: personal tasting
definition: Evidence consisting of one person's own tasting, recorded without a panel or a published source.

LABEL: TAS2R38 PAV/PAV taster group
definition: The genotype-defined taster group whose members carry the PAV haplotype of TAS2R38 on both chromosomes.

LABEL: TAS2R38 PAV/AVI taster group
definition: The genotype-defined taster group whose members carry one PAV and one AVI haplotype of TAS2R38.

LABEL: TAS2R38 AVI/AVI taster group
definition: The genotype-defined taster group whose members carry the AVI haplotype of TAS2R38 on both chromosomes.

LABEL: PROP non-taster group
definition: The phenotype-defined taster group whose members report no bitterness from a propylthiouracil filter-paper strip.

LABEL: PROP medium-taster group
definition: The phenotype-defined taster group whose members report moderate bitterness from a propylthiouracil filter-paper strip.

LABEL: PROP super-taster group
definition: The phenotype-defined taster group whose members report intense bitterness from a propylthiouracil filter-paper strip.
